en.headline: Hong Kong WinterFest opens today with multi-district wonderlands
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s flagship event runs to 5 January with Winter Wonderlands in Central and Tsim Sha Tsui from tonight, and the final Symphony of Lights at 8pm.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s annual WinterFest begins today, 18 November, and continues until 5 January 2027. Organisers said this year’s edition is the largest to date, expanding the Winter Wonderland concept for the first time beyond Central to Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay.

In Central, Statue Square Gardens hosts a Winter Wonderland themed around a Christmas adventure, featuring a 22-metre outdoor tree, interactive installations and light-and-sound performances. The site opens from 8pm to 11.30pm on the first night, then on regular weekday evenings from 4pm and longer hours at weekends. A Christmas market is scheduled mainly on Thursdays to Sundays through early January.

Tsim Sha Tsui’s Prudential Hong Kong Winter Wonderland starts the same evening along the Cultural Centre cluster, with projection shows on the Clock Tower, Hong Kong Museum of Art and Space Museum. Opening night runs from 8.45pm; regular shows are from 7pm to 11pm. Causeway Bay’s hub begins later, on 25 November.

The same evening marks the final performance of A Symphony of Lights, the nightly harbour light-and-music show that has run since 2004. The Tourism Board said the last show, at 8pm, will include special pyrotechnic elements before the programme ends. Admission to the WinterFest installations is free.
The Board said further seasonal light projects will appear at different locations through next year, and that dining and shopping promotions will run alongside the light installations.

zh.headline: 香港繽紛冬日巡禮今日開幕 冬日小鎮擴至多區
zh.dek: 旅發局旗艦活動至1月5日，中環及尖沙咀冬日小鎮今晚起開放，幻彩詠香江晚上8時上演最後一場。
body: 香港旅遊發展局的年度旗艦活動「香港繽紛冬日巡禮」今日（11月18日）正式開幕，一直舉行至明年1月5日。旅發局表示，今屆規模屬歷來最大，冬日小鎮首次由中環擴展至尖沙咀及銅鑼灣。
中環皇后像廣場花園的冬日小鎮以聖誕歷奇為主題，設有22米高的戶外聖誕樹、互動裝置及光影音樂表演。開幕當晚由晚上8時至11時30分開放，其後平日晚上4時起、周末則較長時間開放。聖誕市集主要逢星期四至日舉行至1月初。
尖沙咀保誠保險香港冬日小鎮同期於文化中心建築群展開，鐘樓、香港藝術館及太空館外牆有投影表演。開幕當晚由晚上8時45分開始，其後一般由晚上7時至11時。銅鑼灣的冬日小鎮則於11月25日開始。
同日晚上，「幻彩詠香江」將上演最後一場。這個自2004年起每晚於維港上演的燈光音樂匯演，旅發局表示最後一場於晚上8時舉行，並加入特別煙火元素。冬日巡禮各項裝置免費入場。
旅發局表示，明年會在不同地點陸續推出其他季節性光影項目，同時亦有餐飲及購物優惠配合。
